name: Silent Prayer
overview: Silent prayer is a profound expression of faith where the believer communes with God inwardly, as illustrated in Matthew 6:6, which encourages private, secret prayer to the Father who sees and rewards in secret. Scripture highlights the wisdom in holding one’s peace, as Proverbs 17:28 and 21:23 affirm that controlling speech protects the soul and reflects understanding. The Lord’s presence in silent trust is evident in Exodus 14:14, where God fights on behalf of His people as they remain quiet before Him. This inward posture of the heart, demonstrated in Genesis 24:45 and Psalms 139:1, reveals a deep, personal relationship with God that transcends spoken words.
